author: /root/bos3_d_authority_design

required_fields.generation: nonempty stable operation UUID, fixed before PREPARED and unchanged at ACTIVE
required_fields.phase: PREPARED | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED; only ACTIVE permits resolver
required_fields.root_identity: object {volume_id: nonempty string, file_id: nonempty string}; target root identity
required_fields.lock_identity: object {volume_id: nonempty string, file_id: nonempty string}; permanent target lock identity
required_fields.prepared_receipt: object {path: absolute path strictly within paths.evidence_root, sha256: lowercase 64 hex}
required_fields.migration_acceptance: object {path: absolute path strictly within paths.evidence_root, sha256: lowercase 64 hex}; verdict ACCEPT_MIGRATION_COMMIT binds generation and prepared receipt hash
required_fields.activated_at_utc: UTC ISO timestamp for ACTIVE; null for PREPARED

authority_schema.prepared_semantics: Identity and receipt fields may be null while staging; PREPARED is always unusable. ACTIVE requires every field validated and existing receipts digest-matched. No JSON flag alone proves operations happened.
authority_schema.writer: root migration phase only; normal control tools cannot establish, reset or rewrite authority
authority_schema.live_state_hash_policy: Initial file hashes belong to prepared receipt. Do not require mutable queue/observer/ledger content to remain equal to snapshot after resumption.
authority_schema.trust_boundary: local trusted owner/ACL plus quiescence, not a defence against an administrator forging anchor and receipts

required_state.config.json: existing regular non-reparse file; JSON object and existing config invariants
required_state.queue.json: existing regular non-reparse file; version=1 and tasks object
required_state.observer.json: existing regular non-reparse file; JSON object, preserve fields
required_state.codex-channel-delivery.json: existing regular non-reparse file; schema=1 and messages object; preserve all records and uncertainty
required_state..queue.lock: existing regular non-reparse single-link file with >=1 byte; stable identity matches anchor; never recreated by runtime

resolve_control_home.normalization: absolute ordinary drive paths only; separator/case/trailing separator normalization allowed; reject relative, dotdot, UNC/device/ADS and unlisted aliases before resolving
resolve_control_home.result: the fixed canonical target Path after ACTIVE authority, receipt, path-type, alias/root/lock identity and required-state validation
resolve_control_home.errors: ControlHomeError before any write, mkdir, lock creation, subprocess or AppTools
resolve_control_home.import_side_effects: constants are lexical Paths; no import-time resolve, state/anchor reads or writes

state_lock.validation: accept D or exact compatibility C name through shared resolver; authority before open and after byte lock; fstat lock identity and C/D path identities; refuse generation/phase/identity change
state_lock.scope: single D lock controls state operations; do not hold across AppTools calls

api.initialize: active state validation only, no missing-file bootstrap or reset

deliver.signature: deliver(target, prompt, message_id, home=HOME_DIR, *, model=None, thinking=None)
ordering: private delivery revalidates lock and existing ledger
deliver.cli_send: same preflight order, including self/outside-target refusal before construction
deliver.ledger_missing: refuse; remove both empty-ledger fallback branches

responsibilities: authority resolver and path/file identity validation
single D tools source provider/channel imports without setup shadowing
local_flow.collect and repo_health.locked_inputs resolve home before state reads; never import provider from unvalidated home/tools
authority failure must not become degraded empty-input report or write output directories
rebind source pins and synthetic ledger fixtures
no automatic acceptance of prior flow/wrapper manifests

worker_ownership.root: only live/canonical editor and installer; exact reviewed command sheet and observer map close-out; precise global mcp_servers.bos_control argv update C tools -> D tools with preserved other config and backup; no new installer framework required
worker_ownership.reviewer: independent of both authors; static source review before bounded QA, ACCEPT_MIGRATION_COMMIT before ACTIVE, final installed receipt acceptance before resumption

observer_map.limit: observer local freeze after 06:41 handoff is not global quiescence

bos_lab.treatment: preserve bytes; static C alias compatibility only, new provider import plus state_lock(C)->D; no lab/sync/test execution; altered LOCALAPPDATA or stale provider disqualifies caller

historical_receiver.treatment: retire; do not replay or edit into another event

mcp_registration.existing_worker: source-stale read-only worker may remain only with verified capability restriction; never use for state/send; no Codex/root restart; config update is not live process replacement
mcp_registration.blocker: if write capability/in-flight state operation cannot be excluded, no full quiescence claim

cutover_phases.gate: new core and consumers reviewed at exact hashes; historical attempt budgets reconciled
new bounded synthetic raw outputs independently reviewed, no required missing check
root, observer, workers, direct callers, cached modules, transport calls, registrations and heartbeat stopped/drained with evidence
source regular/reparse/ACL checks, full opaque snapshot hashes and exact destination nonexistence; old lock held during snapshot
nonactive anchor, full D copy and reviewed overlays, new stable D lock; old source retained
source handles closed under maintained quiescence, C same-volume archive then exact junction to D, native alias/root/lock identities equal
independent ACCEPT_MIGRATION_COMMIT binds installed bytes, generation and prepared receipt
root atomically replaces anchor in D parent and rereads; only authority commit point; writers still stopped
bounded allowed in-place verification and independent final receipt; runtime policy remains separate
resume only individually permitted callers; do not launch blocked C64 route or infer runtime readiness

copy_rules.preserve: entire source C tree including backups, tools/settings and thread receipts; no secret content in public report
copy_rules.lock: preserve archived C bytes; create D one-byte lock only during establishment; identity intentionally differs before alias
copy_rules.overlay: reviewed core and bos.ps1 into target/tools; reviewed flow/local_flow/repo_health/wrappers into existing setup, exact setup backups required; root-only precise MCP config argv edit separately backed up

failure_policy.before_active: stop and preserve PREPARED evidence; C archive is unchanged recovery source; no automatic retry/rollback
failure_policy.after_active: D remains authority even if receipt or validation fails; quiesce and reviewed SUSPENDED recovery, never stale-C reset or heuristic ledger merge
failure_policy.unknown_commit_result: inspect persisted anchor/generation and writes before choosing any action; no fallback
failure_policy.junction_failure: block; no alternate link/policy bypass automatically

new_scope: missing or invalid ledger refuses without AppTools
two synthetic Windows processes share one byte lock
phase failure injection and no auto reset
changed_surface_revalidation_with_existi: public and newly scoped CLI target-before-AppTools
qa.fixture: isolated scratch paths; module constants patched before resolver calls, no production test bypass; fake transport; no live home reads
qa.windows_requirement: real isolated Windows junction/lock test; mocked identity or nullcontext is not physical-lock evidence
qa.runtime_gate: reviewed allowed runner only; C64 Windows policy exception remains separate blocked; no other shell/executable to bypass
qa.caps: P05 3/3 and A09/A10/A11 unchanged; no ID, suite rename or agent resets historical attempts

unresolved_inputs: observer final actual consumer and registration map
source subtree reparse/hardlink/ACL metadata at frozen preflight
verified allowed synthetic runner and native Windows identity/junction implementation
